item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: “Lee’s voter turnout encouragement is also division… Who is harming our lives?” (장동혁 “李, 투표 독려도 갈라치기…삶 해치는 게 누구인가”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: “Lee’s voter turnout encouragement is also division… Who is harming our lives?” (장동혁 “李, 투표 독려도 갈라치기…삶 해치는 게 누구인가”)

On the second day of early voting for the June 3 local elections, Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, criticized President Lee Jae-myung’s message urging voter turnout, stating, “Even encouraging voter turnout is being turned into a tool for division.” (6·3 지방 선거 사전투표 둘째날인 30일 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 이재명 대통령의 투표 독려 메시지를 두고 “투표 독려까지 갈라치기 하는 것”이라고 했다.)

In a Facebook post that day, Representative Jang wrote, “Lee Jae-myung, even encouraging voter turnout is an act of division. He claims, ‘Abstaining from voting is not neutrality but siding with those who harm our lives and community.’” He added, “Has he been receiving some kind of ‘mirror therapy’ lately? Who is it that harms our lives with a ‘real estate hell’ and a ‘triple-high crisis’?” (장 대표는 이날 페이스북 글에서 “이재명, 투표 독려까지 갈라치기다. ‘투표 포기는 중립이 아니라 내 삶과 공동체를 해치는 그들을 편드는 것’이란다”라며 “요즘 어디서 ‘거울 치료’라도 받고 있나? ‘부동산 지옥’, ‘3고 지옥’으로 내 삶을 해치는 게 누구?”라고 적었다.)

Representative Jang continued, “Who is it that destroys communities through manipulation and agitation, from mad cow disease, THAAD, Fukushima, to Starbucks? Isn’t it Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party who are ‘those harming our lives and community’?” He added, “So it sounds like we should vote for the People Power Party. I guess I should have taken a closer look at Lee Jae-myung’s ballot yesterday.” (장 대표는 “광우병, 사드, 후쿠시마에 이어 스타벅스까지, 조작과 선동으로 공동체를 파괴하는 게 누구? 이재명과 민주당이야말로 ‘내 삶과 공동체를 해치는 그들’ 아닌가”라며 “그러면 국민의힘 찍으라는 소리네. 어제 이재명 투표용지를 잘 살펴볼 걸 그랬네”라고 했다.)

President Lee posted on his X account that morning, stating, “Voting is the lifeline of democracy,” and “Giving up on voting is the same as giving up on the future of me and my family.” (이 대통령은 이날 오전 자신의 X(엑스) 계정에 “투표는 민주주의의 생명줄이다”라며 “투표를 포기하는 것은 나와 가족의 미래를 포기하는 것과 같다”는 내용의 글을 올렸다.)

President Lee said, “Abstaining from voting is not neutrality but siding with those who harm my life and community.” (이 대통령은 “투표 포기는 중립이 아니라 내 삶과 공동체를 해치는 그들을 편드는 것”이라고 했다.)

The People Power Party has escalated its offensive, accusing President Lee’s actions during early voting the previous day—when he stepped out of the voting booth holding his ballot to ask an election official a question—of being an act of “government-backed electioneering.” (국민의힘은 전날 사전투표에 참여한 이 대통령이 기표 도중 투표용지를 들고 나와 선거사무원에게 문의한 것과 관련해 ‘관권 선거’라며 공세 수위를 높이고 있다)

At that time, President Lee left the voting booth, sought out an official, and asked, “It didn’t stamp the full circle, only half; is that okay?” After being informed that it was fine, he returned to complete his vote. (.당시 이 대통령은 기표소에서 나와 관리원을 찾은 뒤 “동그랗게 안 찍히고 반만 찍혔는데 괜찮나”는 취지로 질의했고, 괜찮다는 안내를 받은 뒤 다시 들어가 투표를 마쳤다.)

Park Sung-hoon, head of the Public Relations Team for the People Power Party’s Central Election Committee, argued in a statement that day, “This is a clear violation of the Public Official Election Act, and it is a highly orchestrated form of election interference, signaling to his supporters and Democratic Party voters, ‘Vote the same way I did for the Democratic Party candidate.’” (박성훈 국민의힘 중앙선대위 공보단장은 오늘 논평에서 “이는 명백한 공직선거법 위반이며, 본인의 지지층과 민주당 유권자들을 향해 ‘내가 찍은 민주당 후보를 똑같이 찍으라’고 타전한 고도의 기획형 선거 개입”이라고 주장했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Abstaining from Voting Means Taking Sides with Those Harming Our Community" (李대통령 “투표 포기, 공동체 해치는 그들 편드는 것”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Abstaining from Voting Means Taking Sides with Those Harming Our Community" (李대통령 “투표 포기, 공동체 해치는 그들 편드는 것”)

On the second day of early voting for the 9th National Simultaneous Local Elections, President Lee Jae-myung urged citizens to vote, stating, "Giving up voting is like giving up the future of yourself and your family." (이재명 대통령은 제9회 전국동시지방선거 사전투표 둘째 날인 30일 “투표를 포기하는 것은 나와 가족의 미래를 포기하는 것과 같다”며 투표를 독려했다.)

In a post titled "Let's Definitely Vote" uploaded to X (formerly Twitter) on the same day, President Lee wrote, "Voting is the lifeline of democracy." He added, "Abstaining from voting is not neutrality; it means taking sides with those who harm my life and our community." (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 올린 ‘꼭 투표합시다’라는 제목의 글에서 “투표는 민주주의의 생명줄”이라고 적었다. 이 대통령은 “투표 포기는 중립이 아니라 내 삶과 공동체를 해치는 그들을 편드는 것”이라고 했다.)

Earlier, on the first day of early voting, President Lee visited a polling station set up at Samcheong-dong Community Center in Jongno-gu, Seoul, near the presidential office, along with his wife Kim Hye-kyung to cast their votes. <<> According to the National Election Commission, as of 9 a.m. on the same day, the national average early voter turnout was recorded at 13.35%. The region with the highest voter turnout nationwide was South Jeolla Province (25.32%), followed by North Jeolla Province (22.08%) and Gangwon Province (16.38%), which ranked third highest. (앞서 이 대통령은 사전투표 첫날인 전날 김혜경 여사와 함께 청와대 인근인 서울 종로구 삼청동 주민센터에 마련된 투표소를 찾아 투표했다.)

Following closely, Gwangju recorded 16.20%. In contrast, the lowest turnout was in Daegu at 10.37%, followed by Gyeonggi Province (11.40%), Incheon (11.81%), and Busan (12.11%). The Seoul region's voter turnout stood at 12.89%, below the national average. (중앙선거관리위원회에 따르면 이날 오전 9시 현재 전국 평균 사전투표율은 13.35%로 집계됐다. 현재 전국에서 가장 투표율이 높은 지역은 전남(25.32%)이며, 전북(22.08%)에 이어 강원(16.38%)이 전국에서 세 번째로 높은 투표율을 보이고 있다.)

item.title: Ruling and Opposition Leadership Go All-Out in Southern Regions and Gangwon on Final Weekend Before June 3 Elections (與野 지도부, 6·3 선거 마지막 주말 남부·강원서 총력전)
item.description:
Ruling and Opposition Leadership Go All-Out in Southern Regions and Gangwon on Final Weekend Before June 3 Elections (與野 지도부, 6·3 선거 마지막 주말 남부·강원서 총력전)

On May 30, the final weekend before the June 3 local elections, the leadership of both the ruling and opposition parties will continue their campaigns in the southern regions and Gangwon, respectively. As the number of competitive districts where support rates for candidates are narrowing increases in the final stage, both the Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party view voter turnout among their support bases and undecided voters as a key factor in determining the outcome, and they are focusing their efforts on boosting turnout starting from the early voting phase. <<> Jung Cheong-rae, acting leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, held a campaign rally on the morning of May 30 at Wando Traditional Market in South Jeolla Province alongside Min Hyeong-bae, candidate for the integrated mayoralty of Gwangju and South Jeolla, and Woo Hong-seop, candidate for Wando County Governor. <<> Acting leader Jung stated, "This local election is an election to choose local workers, but the most important thing is that it is an election to empower President Lee Jae-myung," adding, "This local election is an election to choose local workers, but it is also an election to extinguish the embers of insurrection." <<> Acting leader Jung promised support for local issues such as a kim foundation, the abalone industry, and the Geumil Bridge, and said, "Even to empower President Lee Jae-myung, please be sure to elect Woo Hong-seop as Wando County Governor." <<> After touring South Jeolla areas including Jindo, Jangheung, and Suncheon, acting leader Jung plans to head to Hadong in South Gyeongsang Province later in the afternoon to attend a support rally for Je Yoon-kyung, candidate for Hadong County Governor. On May 31, he plans to visit Gurye, Geumsan, Yeongdong, and Boeun. <<> Democratic Party floor leader Han Byeong-do will visit South Chungcheong and North Jeolla provinces. Floor leader Han will support candidates starting with Maeng Jeong-ho, candidate for Seosan Mayor, followed by Kang Cheol-min, candidate for Taean County Governor, Kim Young-bin, candidate for the Gongju-Buyeo-Cheongyang parliamentary district, and Kim Jeong-seop, candidate for Gongju Mayor. <<> Afterward, he will head to North Jeolla to meet with Park Ji-won, candidate for the Gunsan-Gimje-Buan parliamentary district, and help with campaigning. <<> Floor leader Han has been steadily visiting North Jeolla since May 21 to appeal for support. In North Jeolla, a traditional stronghold of the Democratic Party, Lee Won-taek, the party's candidate for North Jeolla Governor, and Kim Gwan-young, another Democratic Party candidate for North Jeolla Governor, are in a close race. <<> People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk is focusing on Gangwon Province. Leader Jang plans to visit Chuncheon alongside lawmaker Jin Jong-oh, who is from Chuncheon, for a campaign rally. Former President Park Geun-hye had previously held a support rally in Gangwon. <<> People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok will visit North Gyeongsang Province and Daegu. Floor leader Song will support Lee Cheol-woo, candidate for North Gyeongsang Governor, at the Hwanggeum Market in Gimcheon, North Gyeongsang, and then proceed with early voting. Afterward, he plans to visit the Pyeonghwa Market in Gimcheon to appeal for support for Bae Nak-ho, candidate for Gimcheon Mayor. (6·3 지방선거을 앞둔 마지막 주말인 30일 여야 지도부는 각각 남부 지역과 강원을 찾아 유세를 이어간다. 선거 막판 여야 후보 지지율이 좁혀지는 접전 지역이 늘면서 여야 모두 지지층과 부동층의 투표율이 승패를 가를 변수가 될 것으로 보고 더불어민주당과 국민의힘은 사전 투표 단계에서부터 지지층의 투표율을 끌어올리는 데 총력을 기울이고 있다.)

item.title: "Stop Lee’s Election Interference": Opposition Visits Police in Protest Over Seoul City Hall Raid (“李 선거개입 중단하라”…野, ‘서울시청 압수수색’ 경찰 항의 방문)
item.description:
"Stop Lee’s Election Interference": Opposition Visits Police in Protest Over Seoul City Hall Raid (“李 선거개입 중단하라”…野, ‘서울시청 압수수색’ 경찰 항의 방문)

Lawmakers from the People Power Party on the National Assembly's Public Administration and Security Committee visited the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency to protest the police's raid on Seoul City Hall in connection with the investigation into the collapse of the Seosomun elevated roadway. (국민의힘 소속 국회 행정안전위원회 의원들이 경찰이 서소문 고가 차도 붕괴 사고 수사와 관련해서 서울시청을 압수수색한 것에 대해 서울경찰청을 항의 방문했다.)

On the morning of the 30th, People Power Party lawmakers Cho Eun-hee, Park Choong-kwon, Ko Dong-jin, and Park Soo-min went to the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency holding placards that read, "Stop Crown Prince Lee Jae-myung's election interference!" (30일 오전 국민의힘 조은희, 박충권, 고동진, 박수민 의원은 ‘시황제 이재명 선거개입 중단하라!’라는 문구가 적힌 피켓을 들고 서울경찰청을 찾았다.)

They stated that they met with the head of the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency to protest, calling the police's raid on Seoul City Hall a biased investigation and political oppression targeting a specific political faction. (이들은 경찰의 서울시 압수수색이 특정 진영을 향한 편파수사와 정치탄압수사라며 서울경찰청장을 만나 항의했다고 밝혔다.)

Lawmaker Park Choong-kwon said, "The president, who is the chief officer of fair election management, has directly taken up the knife and aimed at the opposition candidate," adding, "The police have abandoned even minimal conscience and legal judgment, acting as tools of power." (박충권 의원은 “공명 선거 관리 총책임자인 대통령이 직접 칼을 쥐고 야당 후보를 겨냥했다”라며 “경찰은 최소한 양심도, 법리판단도 내팽개친 채 권력 수족을 자처했다”라고 했다.)

Lawmaker Park Soo-min criticized the raid as a selective exercise of state power, noting that despite Seoul City's cooperative stance in the investigation, it was the only entity among witnesses subjected to a raid. (박수민 의원은 서울시가 수사에 협조적이었음에도 참고인 중 유일하게 압수수색 당했다며 공권력의 선택적 집행이라고 비판했다.)

The previous day, the People Power Party mentioned a case from the Moon Jae-in administration—when police raided the office of former Ulsan Mayor Kim Ki-hyun (now a People Power Party lawmaker), who had been nominated by the party ahead of the 2018 local elections—and said, "We hope this is not the second season of Cheong Wa Dae's election interference." (국민의힘은 전날엔 문재인 정부 때인 2018년 지방선거를 앞두고 경찰이 국민의힘 공천을 받은 김기현 전 울산시장(현 국민의힘 의원) 비서실을 압수수색했던 사례를 언급하며 “청와대 선거 개입 시즌2가 아니길 바란다”고 했다.)

The Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency's Major Crime Investigation Unit raided seven locations the previous day, including the Seoul Metropolitan Government's Urban Infrastructure Headquarters, the main contractor, and subcontractors. This came just a day after President Lee Jae-myung, during a meeting of senior presidential aides at the presidential office on the 28th, mentioned the Seosomun elevated roadway collapse and missing rebar at the GTX (Great Train Express) Samsung Station, calling for a thorough investigation. (서울경찰청 광역범죄수사대는 전날 서울시 도시기반시설본부를 포함해 원청업체와 하청업체 등 7곳을 압수수색했다. 이재명 대통령이 28일 청와대 수석보좌관 회의에서 서소문 고가차도 사고와 GTX(수도권광역급행철도) 삼성역 철근 누락을 언급하며 “철저한 조사가 필요하다”고 밝힌 지 하루 만이다.)

item.title: Early Voting Rate on Second Day of Local Elections at 8 AM: 12.64%... Up 1.48%p from Four Years Ago (지선 둘째날 사전투표율 오전 8시 12.64%…4년 전보다 1.48%p↑)
item.description:
Early Voting Rate on Second Day of Local Elections at 8 AM: 12.64%... Up 1.48%p from Four Years Ago (지선 둘째날 사전투표율 오전 8시 12.64%…4년 전보다 1.48%p↑ )

The National Election Commission announced on the 30th, the second day of early voting for the June 3 local elections, that the turnout rate stood at 12.64% as of 7 AM. (중앙선거관리위원회는 6·3 지방선거 사전 투표 둘째날인 30일 오전 7시 현재 투표율이 12.64%로 집계됐다고 밝혔다.)

In the early voting that began at 6 AM the previous day, 5,645,207 out of a total of 44,649,908 eligible voters had cast their ballots. (전날 오전 6시부터 진행된 사전투표에서 전체 유권자 4464만9908명 가운데 564만5207명이 투표를 마쳤다.)

This is 1.45 percentage points higher than the early voting turnout rate at the same time during the 8th local elections in 2022 (10.66%). On the other hand, it is 4.22 percentage points lower than the same-time turnout rate in last year's 22nd general election (16.86%) and 8.55 percentage points lower than the 21st presidential election (21.19%). (이는 2022년 제8회 지방선거의 사전투표 동시간대 투표율(10.66%)과 비교하면 1.45%포인트 높다. 반면 지난해 22대 총선 당시 같은 시간 투표율(16.86%)보다는 4.22%포인트, 21대 대통령선거(21.19%)보다는 8.55%포인트 낮은 수준이다.)

The region with the highest turnout so far is South Jeolla Province (24.12%), followed by North Jeolla Province (20.98%). (현재까지 투표율이 가장 높은 지역은 전남(24.12%)이다. 전북(20.98%) 등이 뒤를 이었다.)

The lowest turnout was in Daegu at 9.80%. Other regions include Gangwon Province 15.55%, Gwangju 15.37%, Sejong 13.58%, South Gyeongsang Province 13.45%, North Chungcheong Province 13.02%, Jeju 12.99%, North Gyeongsang Province 12.76%, South Chungcheong Province 12.47%, Seoul 12.21%, Ulsan 11.91%, Daejeon 11.72%, Busan 11.52%, Incheon 11.15%, and Gyeonggi Province 10.76%. (가장 낮은 곳은 9.80%의 대구였다. 이 밖에 강원 15.55%, 광주 15.37%, 세종 13.58%, 경남 13.45%, 충북 13.02%, 제주 12.99%, 경북 12.76%, 충남 12.47%, 서울 12.21%, 울산 11.91%, 대전 11.72%, 부산 11.52%, 인천 11.15%, 경기 10.76% 순으로 이었다.)

Early voting, which began at 6 AM on the 29th, will continue until 6 PM on the same day. (29일 오전 6시 시작된 사전투표는 이날 오후 6시까지 이뤄진다.)

To participate in early voting, voters must bring their ID and visit an early voting station. A total of 3,571 polling stations have been set up nationwide. The locations of polling stations can be checked on the National Election Commission website (www.nec.go.kr) or via the representative phone number (☎1390). (사전투표에 참여하려면 신분증을 반드시 지참하고 사전투표소를 방문해야 한다. 전국에 총 3571개 투표소가 설치됐다. 투표소 위치는 선관위 홈페이지(www.nec.go.kr)나 대표전화(☎1390)로 확인할 수 있다.)

item.title: 'Korea Is a Dagger Pointed at China' Comments Spark Controversy... USFK Commander Says It Was an Explanation of the Operational Environment (‘한국은 中에 단검’ 발언 파장... 주한美사령관 “작전환경 설명한 것”)
item.description:
'Korea Is a Dagger Pointed at China' Comments Spark Controversy... USFK Commander Says It Was an Explanation of the Operational Environment (‘한국은 中에 단검’ 발언 파장... 주한美사령관 “작전환경 설명한 것”)

U.S. Forces Korea Commander General Xavier Brunson, who described South Korea as a "dagger" from China's perspective, stated on the 30th, "I was trying to describe the operational environment we are in." Brunson had previously characterized South Korea as "like an island floating between Japan and mainland China, or a fixed aircraft carrier." However, when he went further and used terms like "dagger," China and others recently voiced opposition. <<> A Blue House official also said on the same day, "We are aware of Commander Brunson's recent series of public remarks, and South Korea and the U.S. have been communicating at various levels on various issues." This led to observations that the Blue House expressed regret over Commander Brunson's comments. <<> In this context, Commander Brunson responded to a question at the 23rd Asia Security Conference (Shangri-La Dialogue) held in Singapore on the 30th, asking whether the "dagger" comment was an official stance of the Trump administration or had been approved by the Pentagon. This question was posed by a Chinese professor in the audience during the Q&A session following a public speech by U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, but Secretary Hegseth had Commander Brunson, who was also in the audience, answer it instead. In response, Commander Brunson said, "I was quoting an expression from a time when Korea was likened to a dagger aimed at Japan," adding, "The overall context of my remarks at the time was about changing perspectives in the region." This suggests that the "dagger" comment was not intended as a hostile statement toward China. <<> Commander Brunson then referenced the phrase "the Korean Peninsula is a dagger pointed at the heart of Japan," attributed to Prussian military advisor Jakob Meckel. That expression was widely used in Japan during the late Joseon period. At the time, Prussia's dagger theory argued that if Korea were controlled by a continental power like Russia or Qing China, the Japanese mainland could be threatened, so Japan should take control first—a logic used to justify Japanese aggression, including the First Sino-Japanese War, the Russo-Japanese War, and the annexation of Korea. <<> Regarding this, Commander Brunson said, "What I was trying to tell the students at the War College was that we need to change our perspective and consider where we are positioned," and that "students must understand and respect others' perspectives in addition to their own." He then mentioned "a map with the Korean Peninsula's east side placed at the top" and said, "Changing the map's perspective allows us to consider how other countries in the region view us. We need to be strong and maintain military capabilities in South Korea, but at the same time, we must understand that those (other countries') perspectives still exist." <<> Commander Brunson also referenced the U.S.-China summit held in China on the 14th, saying, "The President and the Secretary's visit to China was a huge deal" and "because it can enhance relations that allow for dialogue." <<> Earlier, Commander Brunson appeared on a U.S. Army War College podcast on the 22nd and said, "From China's east coast, they see South Korea as a dagger in the heart of Asia." He added, "Beyond that lies Japan, which serves as a kind of shield and last line of defense for China in realizing its ambitions extending into the South China Sea." <<> In response, the Chinese government strongly condemned these remarks as hostile and aggressive. The Chinese Embassy in South Korea issued a statement on the 28th in a Q&A format between its spokesperson and journalists, referencing Commander Brunson's comments and strongly pushing back, saying, "Your remarks have clearly crossed a line." (‘한국은 중국 입장에서 단검(dagger)’이라고 묘사했던 제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관은 30일 “우리가 처한 작전 환경을 설명하려던 것”이라고 했다. 브런슨은 그간 한국을 “일본과 중국 본토 사이에 떠 있는 섬 또는 고정된 항공모함과 같다”고 해왔었다. 그런데 이에서 더 나가 ‘단검’ 등의 표현을 하자 최근 중국 등이 반발해왔다.)

item.title: High Early Voter Turnout… Both Ruling and Opposition Parties Claim "It Benefits Us" (높은 사전투표율에…여야 모두 “우리에게 유리”)
item.description:
High Early Voter Turnout… Both Ruling and Opposition Parties Claim "It Benefits Us" (높은 사전투표율에…여야 모두 “우리에게 유리”)

On the 30th, the last day of early voting for the June 3rd local elections, both the ruling and opposition parties claimed that the higher turnout compared to previous elections "benefits us." The Democratic Party of Korea stated that historically, higher voter turnout has favored the progressive camp, while the People Power Party argued that the high turnout reflects public sentiment to check and judge the Lee Jae-myung administration. (여야는 6·3 지방선거 사전투표 마지막 날인 30일 예전 선거보다 투표율이 높자 서로 “우리에게 유리하다”고 했다. 더불어민주당은 과거 선거에서 투표율이 높을수록 진보 진영이 유리했다고 했고, 국민의힘은 높은 투표율이 이재명 정부에 대한 견제·심판 여론을 보여주는 것이라고 했다.)

As of 1:00 PM on the same day, the early voting turnout stood at 17.5%, higher than the 15.44% recorded during the same period in the 2022 local elections. On the first day alone, this election’s turnout (11.6%) was the highest among all local elections. (사전투표율은 이날 오후 1시 기준 투표율은 17.5%로 2022년 지선 동시간대 투표율(15.44%)보다 높은 상태다. 첫날 기준으로는 이번(11.6%)이 역대 지선 중 가장 높았다.)

Democratic Party Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun said in a press conference at the National Assembly, "Looking at past local, presidential, and general elections, we believe that higher early voting turnout has been encouraging for our party. This also proves that the public is highly interested in the local elections." (민주당 강준현 수석대변인은 이날 국회 기자회견에서 “그동안 지선, 대선, 총선 과정을 보면 사전투표율이 높을수록 저희 당이 고무적이었다고 생각한다”며 “그만큼 국민들이 지선에 관심이 많다는 증명이기도 하다”고 했다.)

In contrast, People Power Party Central Election Campaign Headquarters Publicity Team Leader Park Sung-hoon said in a briefing at the National Assembly, "There was a saying that higher early voting turnout favors the progressive camp, but now that early voting is well established, I think that notion has collapsed." He added, "I believe voters who want to judge the self-righteousness and arrogance of the Lee Jae-myung administration, and those seeking to protect their homes and property, are expressing their anger at the polling stations." (반면 국민의힘 박성훈 중앙선대위 공보단장은 국회 브리핑에서 “사전투표율이 높을수록 진보 진영에 유리하다는 말이 있었지만, 사전투표가 정착된 지금은 그런 말이 무너졌다고 생각한다”고 했다. 이어 “이재명 정부의 독선과 오만을 심판하겠다는 유권자들, 내 집과 재산을 지키려는 유권자들이 투표장에서 분노를 표시하고 있다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, the ruling and opposition parties also clashed over former Presidents Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye’s support rallies for People Power Party candidates. Senior Spokesperson Kang said, "The People Power Party, not content with a 'Yoon repeat,' is even blatantly dragging former Presidents Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye into the election scene. The Lee Myung-bak administration dismantled the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, and the Park Geun-hye administration bankrupted Hanjin Shipping. What right do these people, who undermined Busan's development momentum, have to visit Busan and become supporters of an insurrection-party?" (한편 여야는 이명박 전 대통령과 박근혜 전 대통령의 국민의힘 후보 유세 지원을 두고 이날도 충돌했다. 강 수석대변인은 “국민의힘이 ‘윤어게인’도 모자라 이명박·박근혜 전 대통령까지 노골적으로 선거판에 끌어들이고 있다”며 “이명박 정부는 해양수산부를 해체하고, 박근혜 정부는 한진해운을 파산시켰다. 부산 발전 동력을 저해했던 이들이 무슨 자격으로 부산을 찾아 내란정당 지원군이 되겠다는 것인가”라고 했다.)

In response, People Power Party Team Leader Park said, "We believe the two former presidents are acting as a focal point for conservatism, sending a strong message to the 'shy conservatives' who have been hesitant to vote, urging them to cast their ballots for the People Power Party." He added, "I think they are creating a reason for conservative voters to go to the polls." (반면 국민의힘 박 단장은 “두 전직 대통령이 보수의 구심점이 돼 그간 투표를 주저하고 있던 ‘샤이 보수’에게 국민의힘을 향해 투표해달라는 강력한 메시지를 발신하는 것이라고 생각한다”며 “보수 유권자들에게 투표 명분을 만들어주고 있다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Goes All Out in Pyeongtaek, Accuses “Fake Democratic Party Candidate of Misleading People… No Merger” (평택 총력전 나선 민주당 “가짜 민주당 후보 사람들 현혹…합당 없다”)
item.description:
Democratic Party Goes All Out in Pyeongtaek, Accuses “Fake Democratic Party Candidate of Misleading People… No Merger” (평택 총력전 나선 민주당 “가짜 민주당 후보 사람들 현혹…합당 없다”)

On the final day of early voting for the June 3 by-elections, the Democratic Party of Korea visited the key battleground of Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province, to fully support Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party candidate in the Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly by-election. (6.3 지방선거 사전투표 마지막 날 더불어민주당이 격전지인 경기 평택시를 찾아 김용남 민주당 평택을 국회의원 재선거 후보 총력 지원에 나섰다.)

Cho Seung-rae, Secretary-General of the Democratic Party of Korea, held an on-site headquarters meeting on the morning of the 30th at the election camp of Democratic candidate Kim Yong-nam in Anjung-eup, Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province. Targeting Cho Kuk, candidate of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, he stated, “A fake Democratic Party candidate is misleading people as if he were the real candidate.” (조승래 더불어민주당 사무총장은 30일 오전 경기 평택시 안중읍에 위치한 김용남 민주당 후보 선거캠프에서 현장 본부장단회의를 열고 조국 조국혁신당 후보를 겨냥해 “가짜 민주당 후보가 마치 진짜 후보인 것처럼 사람들을 현혹하고 있다”고 했다.)

Secretary-General Cho said, “The candidate selected by President Lee Jae-myung and nominated by the Democratic Party is Kim Yong-nam,” adding, “Though it’s unlikely, if you vote for the fake Democratic Party, the People Power Party could win. You must support the real Democratic Party.” (조 총장은 “이재명 대통령이 선택하고 민주당이 공천한 후보는 김용남”이라며 “혹시 그럴 일은 없겠지만 가짜 민주당을 찍으면 국민의힘이 당선될 수도 있다. 진짜 민주당을 지원해야 한다”고 했다.)

He also noted, “Recently, the People Power Party has mobilized former presidents to rally conservatives,” and “There appears to be such movement in the Pyeongtaek-eul area as well. Therefore, voting for the fake Democratic Party could put Mr. Kim at risk.” (또 “최근 국민의힘이 전직 대통령들을 동원해 보수결집에 나섰다”며 “평택을 지역에서도 그런 움직임이 있는 것으로 보인다. 그렇기 때문에 가짜 민주당을 찍으면 (김 후보가) 위태로울 수도 있다”고 했다.)

Secretary-General Cho urged, “You must overwhelmingly elect Mr. Kim in Pyeongtaek so that the Lee Jae-myung administration can solidify its governance,” and “Please support Kim Yong-nam, the real Democratic Party candidate.” (조 총장은 “평택에서 김 후보를 압도적으로 당선시켜 주셔야 이재명 정부가 국정 운영을 튼튼하게 할 수 있다”며 “진짜 민주당 후보 김용남을 지원해달라”고 했다.)

On this day, candidate Cho Kuk attended a farewell gathering for the Anjung Nonghyup Donginhoe group outing, visited the Pyeongtaek Mayor’s Cup tennis tournament, and attended a community sports baseball tournament. (이날 조국 후보는 안중농협 동인회 야유회 배웅 인사와 평택시장배 테니스대회, 생활체육 야구대회 방문 일정을 소화했다.)

Candidate Cho posted on Facebook, “Today is the last day of early voting. Please give me, Cho Kuk, the chance to work.” He continued, “More than 3,000 volunteers have voluntarily gathered to help Cho Kuk, the candidate for Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly member,” and “These volunteers, who come together of their own will without expectation of reward, are the strongest driving force of this election. To repay their dedication and sincerity, I will definitely win.” (조 후보는 이날 페이스북에 “사전투표 마지막 날이다. 조국에게 일할 기회를 모아달라”고 했다. 이어 “조국 평택을 국회의원 후보를 돕기 위해 자발적으로 모여든 자원봉사 연인원이 3000명을 넘어섰다”며 “대가 없이, 스스로의 뜻으로 모여드는 자원봉사자들이야말로 이번 선거의 가장 강력한 동력이다. 그 정성과 진심에 보답하기 위해서라도 반드시 당선되겠다”고 했다.)

Candidate Cho plans to attend the Pyeongtaek Park Golf Tournament and the family gathering of the Anjung Uri Moimhoe group. Afterwards, he will conduct street campaigning in the Cheongbuk New Town and Godeok International New Town areas, before visiting a citizen-participation band performance at the outdoor stage in Hambaksan Central Park. (조 후보는 평택 파크골프대회와 안중 우리모임회 가족모임에 참석할 예정이다. 이후 청북신도시와 고덕국제신도시 일대에서 골목 유세를 진행한 뒤 함박산중앙공원 야외공연장에서 열리는 시민 참여 밴드 공연장을 찾는다.)
